text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock C at a gain reminded me that a profit alone is not an exit signal; I should decide in advance what would justify trimming or selling.","I should set clear trade rules and position limits before placing several buys or sells, rather than making each trade in isolation.","My apartment goal has a ten-year horizon, so I should review progress against that goal and keep suitable cash reserves instead of reacting to monthly account changes."]}
